notes: LaunchToken is the Swarmlers ERC-20 (SWARMLER), distinct from the Swarmlers NFT collection. All three application owners resolve through $owner; the factory and tx.origin receive no authority, ownership transfers need acceptance and renouncing is disabled. SwarmlerActivity(initialOwner) verifies current Identity MD ownership and owner-appointed reporter attestations of recent activity. Swarmlers(initialOwner, activityRegistry) provides NFT minting, on-chain artwork, dynamic metadata and funded holding-time rewards in IMD capped at 1 IMD per NFT for its lifetime; unclaimed rewards follow the NFT. Its constructor mints the 25 creator NFTs to the fixed recipient in the approved brief; public minting stays closed until the owner sets the activity reporter and the one-time reward duration and opens minting. Reward capacity is bounded at 2,500 IMD: proceeds beyond what NFTs can still earn are credited to the creator in the same transaction. Permissionless maintenance calls: syncProceeds() recognises unsolicited IMD with the 90/10 split, withdrawCreator() pays the creator credit, checkpoint() retires capped cohorts, refreshMetadata(id) emits metadata updates. SwarmlerHookDeployer(initialOwner, nftCollection, token, manager) pins the SwarmlerFeeHook creation code hash and the Ethereum Uniswap v4 PoolManager 0x000000000004444c5dc75cb358380d2e3de08a90 as an immutable constructor argument, stored without a code probe so launch constructors run on an empty chain; initCodeHash, predict and deploy refuse to run until that address has code. The owner later deploys the child hook with a permission-compatible CREATE2 salt (low 14 bits 0x2503); the child is not a direct project deployment and is not listed here. The child routes realized LP fees from a separate LaunchToken/IMD pool: anyone calls forwardFees() to deposit held IMD into the collection, and token-side fees are sold for IMD at an owner-set ask via buyFeeTokens before forwarding. The factory's launch pool uses its initialization-only guard and fixed fee beneficiaries; redirecting 90% of that launch pool's trading fees to NFT rewards is unsupported by these contracts and remains a policy/application conflict for independent review (the payer may claim those fees and call depositProceeds). The manifest contains no initialization calls and allocates none of the token supply to any contract. initialPrice is the required reference value; the service derives the opening price from policy. Source publication, signed artifact linkage, admission, deployment and frontend publication are subsequent service responsibilities.
